decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful land spells like Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor, which allow for explosive combo plays. By utilizing cards like Azusa and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate extra land drops and play multiple lands per turn, enabling the player to quickly assemble the necessary lands for a devastating combo finish. With the right setup, players can generate a large number of mana and tutor for key lands to overwhelm their opponent in a single turn.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes disruption spells such as Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt while also generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. Additionally, the deck has some graveyard synergy with cards like Underworld Breach and Ledger Shredder.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with a combination of powerful control spells and big red creatures. By using cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon, the deck can shut down enemy strategies while ramping into threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Chandra, Torch of Defiance. The goal is to control the pace of the game, eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By combining control elements with big red threats, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with abilities that synergize well together, such as sacrificing creatures to generate value and create an advantage. The key strategy is to assemble a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and deployed at the right moment to disrupt the opponent's plans and advance the player's own win condition. The deck also utilizes a combo using Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and control the board. By leveraging creature abilities and efficient mana ramping, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a synergistic combination of creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to use Indomitable Creativity to combo with Leyline Binding in order to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck also focuses on controlling the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Lightning Bolt, while also utilizing the flexibility of cards like Fire / Ice and Prismari Command. The mana base is designed to support this strategy, with a mix of fetch lands, shock lands, and utility lands to ensure smooth gameplay and access to all necessary colors.

The main goal of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows the player to play big threats like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also includes control elements like Relic of Progenitus, Oblivion Stone, and Warping Wail to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining ramp, control, and powerful threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and take control of the game.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to copy spells and generate extra value. The inclusion of cards like Leyline Binding and Spell Pierce help control the board and protect the combo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the chances of hitting Dwarven Mine for creature tokens.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to constantly apply pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also utilizes Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and generate value. Additionally, cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Kolaghan's Command provide additional versatility and reach. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt opponent's mana base and give the deck an edge in certain matchups.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly mill the opponent's library by utilizing cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap. The deck also includes various control elements such as Ensnaring Bridge and Drown in the Loch to prevent the opponent from mounting a counterattack. Additionally, cards like Fractured Sanity and Tasha's Hideous Laughter provide additional mill options while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent's resources and win through decking them out rather than traditional combat damage.

decks.player: Hotta Shingo (Team Fishery Union Aichi Branch)
decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also ramping up mana and card advantage. By using planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, the deck aims to control the board and slow down the opponent. It also includes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to create pressure and close out the game. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing for powerful plays in the late game.

decks.player: Sawada Ryo (Team Fishery Union Aichi Branch)
decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly deploying a board full of Merfolk creatures that benefit from lords like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis to pump up their power and toughness. Key cards like Aether Vial and Force of Negation help protect the board and disrupt opponents, while cards like Spreading Seas help control the opponent's resources. The Merfolk synergies and aggressive game plan aim to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy.

decks.player: Mizuno Toyoharu (Team Fishery Union Aichi Branch)
decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to deal damage quickly while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to finish off the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga provide card advantage and consistency, while also including some artifact synergies. The deck also includes some disruption with cards like Pithing Needle and Relic of Progenitus to help control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy.
